song_craft: Voice: śānta couplets, mirror-light register (still, clear, unforced). Arc: light unobjectifiable (v1) → non-duality (v2) → positive declaration with division inside (v3) → difference uncut + bare list (v4) → mirror a-fortiori (v5) → address: You alone (v6) → paradox praised (v7) → seal: hymn names its close (v8). Sthāyin śānta throughout; adbhuta/ānanda color single verses. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: Nothing at all stands dually apart from knowledge; made of this and that, in consciousness there is no split.
From self-luminosity, a hundredfold, in the one abode — the individual would never be divided.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jñānadvibhinno na hi kaścidarthaḥ tattatkṛtaḥ saṃvidi nāsti bhedaḥ | svayamprakāśācchatam aikadhāmni prātisvikī nāpi vibheditā syāt

verses.craft: Hundredfold kept as printed (UNC: against tempting satatam); never-divided close.
verses.rejected: (a) always → killed by UNC held-open. (b) split→difference → killed: L3 frozen.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC) / C1 essence / rasa śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) / L2+L3 voice
